title: The Best AI Notetakers for Remote Teams
summary: Compare the best AI Notetakers for remote teams, and see which ones work with Gather meetings, including Granola, Fellow, Fathom, and more.
body_markdown:
AI Notetakers are a standard part of video calls these days. Whether they’re built into your meeting software, listening to your computer audio, or joining the call as a bot, AI notes are just part of digital meetings.


Gather has its own[AI meeting notes](https://support.help.gather.town/articles/4822083973-meeting-recording-notes?lang=en) , including a full transcript and summary. Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams all have similar features to turn conversations into notes and action items.


While the built-in options are great, we also know many of our users appreciate the more advanced features and workflows that dedicated notetakers can provide, so this guide covers the best AI Notetakers (plus how each one works with Gather) to help you pick what's right for your team.


**The Best AI Notetakers for Remote Teams:**


-


**Granola:** a botless notepad that enhances your own notes. *Works with Gather.*


-


**Fellow:** agendas, notes, and follow-ups in one place. *Works with Gather.*


-


**Wispr Flow:** accurate transcripts, plus dictation. *Works with Gather.*


-


**Fireflies:** a searchable library of every meeting. *Works with Gather.*


-


**Fathom:** quick AI summaries and action items with easy consent features. *Works with Gather.*


-


**Claude Meetings:** Claude joins Google Meet calls to take notes and help in real time.


## [Granola](https://www.granola.ai/)


### **Best for:** People who like taking their own notes and want AI to fill in the gaps


Granola works like a notepad. You jot down quick notes during the meeting, and it combines them with the transcript to produce a polished summary. It records audio from your computer, so no bot has to join the call.


**Works with Gather?** Yes. Because it captures audio on your machine, it works in Gather meetings. It prompts you when a meeting starts, and only records once you say so.


## [Fellow](https://fellow.ai/)


### **Best for:** Managers and teams that run on agendas and action items


Fellow covers the whole meeting. You build agendas ahead of time, capture notes during the call, and assign follow-ups afterward, which suits recurring 1:1s and team syncs.


**Works with Gather?** Yes. Fellow’s botless recording captures your computer audio, so it works with any meeting, including conversations in Gather. You can also take a Gather recording and upload it to Fellow to keep everything in one place.


## [Wispr Flow](https://wisprflow.ai/)


### **Best for:** People who want AI notes and dictation in the same subscription


Wispr Flow is best known for voice dictation, but it recently launched a meeting notetaker. It uses your calendar and personal dictionary to spell names and jargon correctly, has a “What did I miss?” recap for when your attention drifts, and lets you connect your meeting history to Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini.


**Works with Gather?** Yes. It captures audio from your computer, with no bot and no integrations to set up.


## [Fireflies](https://fireflies.ai/)


### **Best for:** Teams that hold meetings across several tools and want one archive for all of them


Fireflies records, transcribes, and stores your meetings in a searchable library, and it connects with a long list of business tools. It’s especially useful when your team meets across several platforms and wants one archive.


**Works with Gather?** Yes, with the Fireflies desktop app. Fireflies' meeting bot can't join Gather, but the desktop app records audio from your computer, so it works in Gather meetings. You can also upload a Gather recording.


## [Fathom](https://www.fathom.ai/)


### **Best for:** Teams that want built-in recording consent tools


Fathom is popular for simple setup and quick summaries and action items, and its newer desktop app can record without a bot. It also takes consent seriously, with email notices, meeting chat messages, or both.


**Works with Gather?** Yes. Fathom's bot-free recording captures audio from your computer, so it works in Gather meetings. (Its meeting bot only joins its supported apps, so use bot-free mode.)


## [Claude Meetings](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/18325154-use-claude-meetings)


### **Best for:** Teams already using Claude and Google Meet


This is a new beta feature Anthropic recently announced that lets Claude join video calls as a participant, giving Team and Enterprise customers notes, transcripts, and action items from Google Meet calls at no extra charge. Claude can also help in the moment, like drafting plans or answering questions.


**Works with Gather?** Not yet (since it’s only available for Google Meet) but we’re keeping a close eye on it. For now, you can always use Gather’s native recording and upload it to Claude. We’re also working on the[Gather MCP](https://www.gather.town/roadmap) to make that connection even smoother. Stay tuned!


## **Gather’s built-in AI notes**


If your team already uses Gather as your virtual workspace, try our built-in AI notes. Hit record in a meeting, and Gather gives you a full transcript and AI notes when it ends. There’s nothing to install or connect since it’s just built into Gather.


Meetings in Gather are never recorded automatically, by design. Recording starts only when someone on the call presses the record button, and only Members who were present at the start of the meeting can access the recording in Gather. You can export the recording and transcript or grab them from the email notification after the meeting ends.


## **Benefits of a dedicated AI Notetaker**


The built-in options are great, but their biggest limitation is that they only work on their own platform. If you go with a dedicated AI meeting note app, it’ll work across meeting tools and offer advanced note-taking features.


**The primary benefits:**


-


**One notetaker across every tool.** If your team meets in Gather and another platform, you get one place for all the notes.


-


**A single searchable history.** Look up what was said in any meeting, not only the ones in one tool.


-


**Integrations.** Some tools push notes and action items into your CRM, project manager, or chat.


-


**More control over the output.** Templates, agendas, and follow-up workflows that go beyond a summary.


## **To recap: Which AI Meeting App should you pick?**


-


**Meeting in Gather and want easy notes?** Use Gather’s built-in AI notes.


-


**Want a dedicated tool that works with Gather directly?** Granola, Fellow, Wispr Flow, Fireflies, and Fathom all capture audio from your computer.


-


**Already using Claude?** Record in Gather, export, and upload.


## **FAQ**


### **Does Gather have built-in AI meeting notes?**


Yes. Record a meeting in Gather and you get a full transcript and AI notes.


### **Does Gather record meetings automatically?**


No, and that’s by design. Most conversations in Gather are quick, less than 10-minute check-ins rather than formal meetings. (In other words, conversations that don’t need to be recorded.) Of course, if you would like to record a meeting and generate the AI notes, all you have to do is press record.


### **What meeting tools include AI Notes?**


Most video tools now include an AI notetaker, though some keep it behind a paid plan:


-


[Gather](https://www.gather.town/pricing) **:** built-in AI notes for all Members of your[virtual office](https://www.gather.town/virtual-office)


-


[Zoom](https://zoom.us/pricing?_ics=1795547100403&irclickid=%7Eeh931YSMRJCFGKMUXY390QROFxmnquyEukglmcd80SIyolfa763U&_gl=1*s6jj9v*_gcl_au*MjAxODYyMTc2MC4xNzkxNTU2Njgw*_ga*MTAyODAzMDA4MC4xNzk1NTQ3MTAw*_ga_L8TBF28DDX*czE3OTU1NDcwOTkkbzEkZzAkdDE3OTU1NDcwOTkkajYwJGwwJGgw) **:** AI features are included at no additional cost with eligible paid plans, and free accounts get limited use, around three meetings a month.


-


[Google Meet](https://workspace.google.com/pricing?source=gafb-meet-globalnav-en&hl=en&ga_region=noram&ga_country=us&ga_lang=en&uj=gafb-meet-globalnav-en) **:** Gemini in Meet can summarize, translate, and take notes in meetings on Google Workspace Business Standard, Business Plus, and Enterprise plans.


-


[Microsoft Teams](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-teams/compare-microsoft-teams-business-options) **:** Intelligent Recap requires Teams Premium or Microsoft 365 Copilot, and live AI notes require a Copilot license.


### **Do I need a dedicated AI notetaker?**


Not necessarily. If your meeting tool’s built-in notes cover what you need, you’re set. A dedicated app helps when you want one tool across all your team’s meetings or deeper workflows.
